lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient peak divided by uniform-bin mean after a local separable Lanczos3 reproduction of the 2560 px pipeline derivation; mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: No directional key, cast-shadow field, sun angle, time-of-day gradient, or consistent lit-side direction was observed; shading is local form shading and ambient occlusion.
lighting_isotropy.risk: The local numeric proxy remains 0.015132 over the inherited ceiling after two whole-canvas generation attempts. Predominant east-west gorge-face gradients may contribute, but that explanation is an inference and does not override the failed proxy.

palette_conformance.metric: Median per-pixel blue/green ratio over vegetation-classified pixels using one identical classifier for source, context, and seed

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median visual crown-width sample across mature conifers, converted by 2560/1254 to final canvas scale.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Authoring-zone estimate from the broad coherent saddle and gorge-rim shelf versus exposed central basalt faces; remaining land is broken, talus-covered, scrubbed, or vegetated.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels
water_mask.method: Source-registered smooth connected silhouette following the painted beck; includes dark channel water, water between rocks, riffle highlights, the complete fall column, splash, spray, foam, reflections, and visibly wet margins. The selected terrain source remained byte-identical.

local_lanczos3_pipeline_proxy.note: The mask is binary at source resolution. Local Lanczos3 interpolation produces a narrow partial-alpha transition at final scale; the painted fringe classifier remains below its ceiling.

image_generation.candidate_1_rejected_reason: Vegetation palette passed, but the local final-scale lighting-isotropy proxy measured 1.464053 against the inherited 1.45 ceiling.
image_generation.candidate_2_selection_reason: Closest context-palette match, clearer broad saddle, one south-running beck and one fall, all-land east edge, and solid south land edge apart from the stream crossing.
image_generation.two_strike_stop: Both whole-canvas candidates remained marginally above the inherited isotropy ceiling; no third attempt or regional patch was made.

open_risks: Lighting isotropy is a local mechanical fail at 1.465132 versus 1.45; the candidate must not be promoted on this report alone.
Visual quality, exact east-neighbour seam continuity, and final owner judgment remain unverified by mechanical checks.
